description: an athletic young woman archer of the thunder god with a long fair blond braid and a silver circlet, a long dark blue coat with gold embroidered thunder symbols, a silver breastplate with a golden six-petal thunder rosette, silver pauldrons with lightning-shaped edges, brown boots, one long oak bow strapped upright on the back behind the shoulder, the whole bow above the waist and behind the body, never in front of the legs, beside a quiver of blue-fletched arrows, nothing in the hands, seen exactly from the side in a strict profile, facing and walking to the right, the nose pointing right and only one eye showing, the chest, belly and hips turned fully to the right and not towards the viewer, only the near arm showing, hanging relaxed beside the body with an empty loosely closed hand, the far arm hidden behind the body, the back and shoulders straight and upright, upright mid-step in the pose of the grey mannequin, the same size and place as the mannequin, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet inside the image, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy
